duplicate_character: Most repeated hashes are Outlook/vendor branding, signature graphics, repeated ADP marketing assets, duplicate tiny attachment stubs, or repeat inline images across related messages.

findings: Most generic image00x attachments are logos, social-network icons, vendor branding, email-signature graphics or decorative resource imagery.
Several photos/screenshots/receipts/credentials are person-level or case-level evidence and remain restricted.
Social/non-work photographs were not promoted into work/company/person profiles.
No previously hidden blank HR form, policy, compliance workbook or major process artifact was found solely in the generic image layer.
2026 UHC wellness imagery accompanies already-modeled wellness resources and adds no separate policy authority.

dedup_rule: SHA-256 exact duplicates should be analyzed once and linked to every message occurrence. Different completed documents must never be collapsed merely because they share a template/form type.
privacy_rule: Hashes and sanitized classification are durable; restricted image/payload content remains local.
